newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end sharply up on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end sharply up on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks climbed more than one percent at Friday's close on buying of blue chips by foreign investors, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 18.52 points, or 1.17 percent, up at 1,600.80 amid 161 gainers and 89 losers.

Lever Brothers jumped 46 rupees to 750, PTCL rose 0.40 to 30.55, Hub Power 0.10 to 37.55, ICI Pakistan 0.75 to 23.45, Dewan Salman 0.85 to 39.15, Engro Chemical 3.00 to 184, Dawood Hercules 5.00 to 155 and Fauji Fertiliser 2.50 to 84.
